lines.text: Meet Maya. Level one: gut guesser.
Something's felt off for months. Bloating. Weird bathroom days. Low energy.
At the doctor, the questions come fast. Since when? How often? After what?
So it ends with: could be stress, let's keep an eye on it.
One. Log it when it happens, not from memory.
Two. Note what came before: meals, sleep, stress, your cycle.
Three. Give it a few weeks, so a pattern can repeat.
Four. Bring a summary, not a story.
Back at the doctor, the questions have answers.
Get Regular turns your daily logs into a report you can bring to your doctor.
